source_fact_policy: Every mapped proposition is a restatement of one or more cited collector claim IDs. No browser observation, source fact outside the ledger, or acceptance claim is added.

scene_state_transition_model.statement: The mapped source surface includes a configured logical world and playing-state fields for lives, score, combo, ordered words, target progress, objects, attempts, sentence completion, timing, spawning, and player lane.
The source-defined start path rejects empty vocabulary, selects and splits a sentence, initializes three lives and zero progress, clears objects, and places the player in the center lane.
During the playing phase, lane switching is bounded to the left, center, and right lanes, and wave construction creates the cited obstacle or gate arrangements at the cited depth.

Each source-defined tick advances object depth and resolves the collision band only when an object's lane matches the player lane; incorrect outcomes reduce lives and reset combo, while correct gates advance score, answers, combo, collected words, and target progress, with the last word setting victory.
The source contains a lane-and-depth projection and a Stage sizing path for the configured logical surface.
The source page constructs sentence-data and completion-request paths for the named game flow.
The withdrawn cartridge source declares a Phaser configuration, semantic asset slots, traversal bindings, and an update path that advances and completes its model when its cited conditions are met.

mechanics_learning_model.statement: The mapped learning surface is ordered-word traversal: correct gates advance collected-word and target progress, while an incorrect gate applies the cited life and combo consequence.

The source-defined traversal input path translates directional changes into bounded lane changes during playing; the withdrawn cartridge separately declares keyboard, touch-region, and swipe bindings.
